script.title: Imperial Star Destroyer — Devastator
script.description: A 144-stud dagger hull with inclined armor, recessed equatorial trenches, seven luminous engines, a terraced command citadel, twin shield generators and an illuminated ventral docking bay. A removable black cradle supports the ship.
